$schema: Manifest schema for ECHO project wiki ingestion. The lead agent generates .manifest.json following this structure.

<folder>/<filename>.md.title: Display name for index.md
<folder>/<filename>.md.summary: One-line description for index.md (written by lead agent, never parsed from page content)
<folder>/<filename>.md.raw: path/to/source/file.md (source pages only, omit for principles/surfaces/architecture)
<folder>/<filename>.md.lifecycle: active (default, may be omitted) | deferred | retired
<folder>/<filename>.md.deferred_owner: who owns the parked commitment (required when lifecycle: deferred)
<folder>/<filename>.md.deferred_trigger: the explicit condition that would reopen the parked commitment (required when lifecycle: deferred)
<folder>/<filename>.md.superseded_by: path/to/superseding decision or page (required when lifecycle: retired)

_rules.filenames: kebab-case, globally unique across all folders. Prefix with src- if a name would collide elsewhere.
_rules.link_field: Filename only. No folder prefix, no .md extension. Agents copy this into [[link]] verbatim.
_rules.status_field: shipped = the page documents reality that exists (code merged, decision locked, research logged). planned = a V1-locked commitment whose underlying thing is specced but not yet built. The wiki is lagging-doc; aspirational pages must say so explicitly via this field.
_rules.summary_field: Max 120 chars. Written during manifest generation so consolidation never parses page content.
_rules.aliases_field: Must include at least the Title Case version of the filename. Obsidian uses these to resolve [[wikilinks]].
_rules.topic_field: Must match the taxonomy below. Reuse existing topics before creating new ones.
_rules.raw_field: Relative path from project root. Only on pages whose authority is a separate source file (e.g., capture-allowlist mirrors src/capture/sources.ts).
_rules.lifecycle_field: Separate axis from status (2026-07-11). status stays delivery-state (shipped|planned); lifecycle says whether the page is strategically current. active = current authority (default when omitted). deferred = unbuilt commitment intentionally parked with an owner/trigger. retired = formerly current/shipped, now superseded — page body is historical evidence, not direction. Never infer current product direction from status: shipped alone.
_rules.deferred_owner_field: Required with lifecycle: deferred. Names who owns the parked commitment (e.g. founder). Mirrors the page's own frontmatter deferred_owner.
_rules.deferred_trigger_field: Required with lifecycle: deferred. States the explicit condition that would reopen the parked commitment. Mirrors the page's own frontmatter deferred_trigger. tools/wiki_index.py errors (exit 2) if a lifecycle: deferred entry lacks either deferred_owner or deferred_trigger.
_rules.superseded_by_field: Required with lifecycle: retired; points at the superseding decision doc or wiki page. Mirrors the page's own frontmatter superseded_by + dated banner.

_folders.product/: Strategic 'what' — locked V1 scope, target cohort, brand, sequencing decisions
_folders.principles/: Active commitments and disciplines: design, brand, scope-discipline. What we believe and hold.
_folders.architecture/: The durable middle — substrate components and the canonical models (system-architecture, interface-layers)
_folders.capture/: Layer 1 capture surfaces — per-source watchers and extractors (substrate's left edge)
_folders.capture/per-app/: Field-level reference for what each connected app contributes (cursor, claude-code, github, slack, web-extension, ...)
_folders.surfaces/: Layer 3 + Layer 5 — what users and AI clients touch (MCP, hotkey overlay, audit page, browser extension)
_folders.research/: Validation work — wedge / thesis / cohort / funnel research
_folders.operating-model/: Process meta — wave retrospectives, drift audits, and other build-process artifacts

_consolidation.index.md: Auto-generated by tools/wiki_index.py from .manifest.json. Grouped by folder (in narrative order: product, principles, architecture, capture, capture/per-app, surfaces, research, operating-model), then by topic within folder. Each line: - [[link|title]] — summary, with planned pages tagged inline.
_consolidation.log.md: Append one entry per operation with timestamp, operation type, and page counts.
